programs.title: Insecure
programs.desc: Issa Dee (Issa Rae), a twenty-something African American woman, lives in Los Angeles.Although she experiences many humiliations, she tries to fight against her chronic lack of self-confidence and her own weaknesses.The lack of money and work problems don't help her at all.Her best friend is Molly (Yvonne Orji), a self-centered lawyer.The series tells the story of the lives of contemporary black women living in the United States.Its originator and producer is the main actress, Issa Rae (First).The artist gained popularity thanks to the website The Misadventures Of Awkward Black Girl and her YouTube channel - so far she has collected over 200,000 likes.followers and 20 million plays.Yvonne Orji (Love That Girl!), Jay Ellis (The Rules of the Game) and Lisa Joyce (It's Never Too Late) will also appear on screen.Critics compare the series to the cult HBO production titled "Girls".

programs.title: The Last of Us
programs.desc:
Twenty years have passed since the destruction of civilization.Joel Miller (Pedro Pascal) is a battle-hardened survivor.One day, a man is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie (Bella Ramsey) out of the oppressive quarantine zone.What begins as a simple assignment soon becomes a dangerous and heartbreaking journey across the old United States.During this expedition, they both begin to understand that they can only rely on each other to survive.Based on the popular video game of the same title
Joel and Ellie wander through a desolate forest area.The man finds it difficult to come to terms with Tess's death.He still doesn't accept the teenager's company.Together they reach the empty building where Joel hid supplies years ago.The next destination of their trip is Bill and Frank's fortress.The year 2003. Survivalist Bill is hiding in his house.When the army deports all the inhabitants of his town, they surround the area with barbed wire, install traps for the infected and stockpile supplies.Four years later, a hungry wanderer, Frank, reaches him.Since the man is not infected, it is agreed to feed him.Ultimately, Frank stays in Bill's house for many years.The two start working with smugglers Tess and Joel.

programs.title: The Outrun
programs.desc: A young woman named Rona (Saoirse Ronan), who has recently left an addiction treatment center, returns from London to her native Scotland, to one of the islands of the Orkney archipelago.Because her parents are separated, she lives alternately with her mother, where she meets with her religious friends, and with her father, whom she helps on the farm.At the same time, she is still trying to cope with difficult memories - the beginning of her stay in London, where she started studying biology and often went to clubs with her boyfriend Daynin (Paapa Essiedu).She didn't even notice when she fell into alcoholism, which led to problems in her relationship and began to destroy her life.Meanwhile, while staying on the island, Rona decides to return to London.However, already on the ferry he feels that he is unable to control the urge to drink alcohol.He must re-plan his life.

programs.title: Half Man
programs.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programs.title: The Alto Knights
programs.desc: The year is 1957. Former friends from their youth, Frank Costello (Robert De Niro) and Vito Genovese (Robert De Niro), are now the most famous New York bosses, fighting for control of the city streets.When one day the first of them becomes the target of a failed assassination attempt by his rival, he decides it's time to step aside.He informs Vita about this, but he - a man paranoid about losing power - does not believe him.Soon he orders another attack.His victim is Albert Anastazja (Michael Rispoli), appointed by Frank as his successor.This event makes Costell realize that if he does not stop his rival, he will again attempt to kill both him and his loved ones.The conflict between two former friends and now rivals escalates, leading to a dramatic climax.A film inspired by real events.

programs.title: Assassin's Creed
programs.desc: Recidivist Callum Lynch sentenced to death is not executed.After a fake execution, he ends up in a secret laboratory.There he meets Rikkin and his daughter Sofia.Scientists have a mysterious device that allows them to access the records of ancestors' actions stored in their genes.The criminal is to connect with the consciousness of Aguilar from Spain, who lived during the Great Inquisition and obtained the Apple of Eden, which provides control over emotions.By using this item, you can supposedly eliminate aggression in people.The daredevil travels to the Middle Ages.He discovers that he is a descendant of a member of the Assassin secret society.Over time, he learns what a big mistake he made when he trusted Sofia and her father.
